# PracticeRank — Full Content Index

> PracticeRank (practicerank.ai) is a fully managed AI-powered dental marketing platform. It gets dental practices found everywhere patients search: Google Search, Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Apple Maps, Siri, and 20+ local directories. Pricing: three tiers (Optimize, Grow, Dominate) based on each practice's market and goals, month-to-month with no long-term contracts. Every engagement starts with a free PracticeRank Score and is backed by a 90-day results-or-refund guarantee. Founded by Kody Doherty, Matt Toone, and Ethan Mandelup (Lost Relic). Contact: kdoherty@practicerank.ai.

---

## Home

### [PracticeRank — AI-Powered Marketing for Dental Practices](https://practicerank.ai)

PracticeRank is a dental marketing platform built for the AI search era. The way patients find dentists is changing: most patients research online before booking, the Google Maps 3-pack captures a large share of local clicks, and a fast-growing share of patients now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, or Perplexity for dentist recommendations.

Unlike Google Ads, AI search visibility cannot be purchased — practices either show up or they don't. The practices that optimize now build an advantage that compounds. PracticeRank handles the entire process.

"Most dental practices are effectively invisible in AI search results. They're spending $5,000 to $10,000 per month on agencies that only optimize for Google — while a growing share of patients ask AI for recommendations and get sent to a competitor." — Kody Doherty, Co-Founder

**Why it matters:**
- Most patients research online before choosing a dentist
- A fast-growing share of patients now use AI assistants for dentist recommendations
- The Google Maps 3-pack captures a large share of local clicks — if you're not in the top 3, you're easy to miss
- AI search positions compound — early movers build a lasting advantage
- Many dental practices have not fully claimed or optimized their Apple Maps and directory listings
- Optimized directory listings drive more calls than incomplete ones (BrightLocal, local search research)
- Average dental patient lifetime value: $800-$2,500+

PracticeRank Score: A 0-100 rating of your dental practice's online visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, AI search engines, review platforms, and local directories. The audit is free and benchmarks your practice against 10+ local competitors.

## What PracticeRank Does

### [How We Get You More Patients](https://practicerank.ai/#what-we-do)

**Service Pages:**
- [AI Search Optimization](https://practicerank.ai/ai-search-optimization) — detailed guide to AEO/GEO for dental practices
- [Dental SEO](https://practicerank.ai/dental-seo) — comprehensive dental SEO services
- [Google Maps Optimization](https://practicerank.ai/google-maps-optimization) — Google Business Profile and Maps 3-pack optimization

PracticeRank handles what a dental practice needs to get found online — across the platforms patients use to search. The service is fully managed: practices spend about 15 minutes granting access during setup, then a few minutes per month reviewing results.

**AI Search Visibility:**
When patients ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, or Perplexity "who's the best dentist near me?", we work to make sure your practice is structured to be found and cited. We implement the structured data, AI-readable content, and llms.txt signals AI platforms rely on when deciding which practices to surface.

**Google Maps Dominance:**
The Maps 3-pack captures a large share of local dental clicks. PracticeRank manages the entire Google Business Profile: regular posts, professional photos, Q&A optimization, category management, review monitoring, and AI-drafted responses. Practices with optimized, active profiles consistently outperform those with neglected listings.

**Review & Reputation Engine:**
A branded review funnel that routes happy patients to Google and intercepts unhappy feedback privately before it reaches public platforms, plus AI-drafted responses to reviews. Reviews are one of the strongest local-ranking factors, so we build steady volume and recency.

**Content That Converts:**
Fresh, expert-level content published to practice websites every month, driven by your real search data. Stale websites get buried in search results — AI systems and search engines both prioritize recently updated content. PracticeRank keeps practice websites current, relevant, and ranking.

**Apple Maps & Directory Visibility:**
Apple Maps is the default navigation on every iPhone, and many practices haven't fully claimed or optimized it. PracticeRank claims, optimizes, and maintains listings across Apple Maps and 20+ healthcare and local directories so patients find the practice no matter where they search.

**Referral Program:**
Automated referral prompts after positive reviews, turning satisfied patients into a growth channel.

Month-to-month. Cancel anytime. No long-term contracts. Each tier is priced to your market and goals — book a strategy call for a quote tailored to your practice.

A full plan bundles work that agencies typically bill for piece by piece — AI search visibility, Google Maps management, review engine, referral program, search intelligence, monthly content, local pages, Apple Maps, directories, competitor monitoring, and reporting — delivered as one managed plan for a fraction of the combined a-la-carte cost.

**ROI framing:**
- Average dental patient lifetime value: $800-$2,500+
- A small number of new patients per month covers the fee
- Results vary by market — which is exactly why we offer the guarantee below

**90-Day Results-or-Refund Guarantee:**
If your PracticeRank Score doesn't improve by 20+ points in 90 days, you receive a full refund of your monthly fees — and you keep every asset built (content, review engine, all of it). The guarantee assumes timely access to the accounts we need to do the work.

## How It Works

### [Getting Started with PracticeRank](https://practicerank.ai/#how-it-works)

**Step 1: Free Audit (2 minutes)**
Enter your website and get your PracticeRank Score — a competitive analysis benchmarking your practice against 10+ local competitors across Google, Maps, reviews, and AI search.

**Step 2: Strategy Call (20 minutes)**
Walk through your results. See which competitors are beating you, why, and what can be done. No pressure, no obligation.

**Step 3: We Execute (15 minutes of your time)**
Grant access to your Google Business Profile, website, and analytics. PracticeRank handles everything else.

**Step 4: Measurable Reporting**
Most practices see measurable improvements in the first 30-90 days, and we report progress every month.

## FAQ

### [Frequently Asked Questions](https://practicerank.ai/#faq)

**What is AI search and why should I care?**
A fast-growing share of patients now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and other AI assistants for dentist recommendations. When they ask "who's the best dentist near me?" — is your name coming up? Unlike Google Ads, you can't buy AI visibility. Practices that optimize their structured data and content now build an advantage that compounds.

**How is PracticeRank different from my current SEO company?**
Traditional agencies typically only optimize for Google and charge $5,000-$10,000/month. PracticeRank gets you found across Google, Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Perplexity, Apple Maps, and 20+ directories — in one plan with no long-term contracts.

**How long until I see results?**
We target measurable improvements within the first 30-90 days and report progress monthly. If we don't improve your score 20+ points in 90 days, you get a full refund of your monthly fees.

**How much of my time does this require?**
About 15 minutes during setup, and a few minutes per month after that. We handle the rest.

**What's your guarantee?**
Full refund of monthly fees if we don't improve your score 20+ points in 90 days. You keep everything we built. No long-term contracts — cancel anytime.

**I already run Google Ads. Do I still need this?**
Ads get you patients today, but you're renting that traffic. PracticeRank builds assets that compound: AI visibility, reviews, organic presence. The best practices run both — they multiply each other.
